note: Despair as defect opposed to hope
Precipitation arises from a defect in counsel or deliberation.
Thoughtlessness arises from a defect in judgment.

ref: ST II-II Q53 A2; Q53 A5
note: Inconstancy arises from a defect in command; when reason fails to command what has been counselled and judged.
Insensibility is a defect opposed to temperance.
Deficient play is a defect opposed to eutrapelia.
